meta.title: Luxor backend console
meta.description: A same-origin browser console for exercising the Luxor reference API: authentication, permissions, cache, queue, realtime WebSockets, OpenTelemetry, and WebAssembly demos.
hero.eyebrow: Rust · Axum · PostgreSQL · Redis · WebSockets · OpenTelemetry · WebAssembly
hero.title: Luxor backend console
hero.intro: A small same-origin client for exercising the reference API. Access tokens live only in this page’s memory.
langSelector.label: Language
service.title: Service
service.body: Check the public health and clock endpoints.
auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Register or sign in against PostgreSQL-backed sessions. New accounts take the selected role.
auth.logoutResult: Refresh session revoked and cookie removed.
session.none: No active session. Log in or register to use the protected endpoints.
cache.title: Cache
cache.invalidJson: Cache value must be valid JSON.
permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.body: Each role carries a fixed set of grants — chosen at registration and enforced server-side. Call the endpoints below as each role to watch the same request succeed or fail.
queue.title: Queue
queue.body: Enqueue an audit event using the documented Redis list message contract.
realtime.title: Realtime
realtime.body: Exchange a short-lived, single-use ticket for a WebSocket, then watch the server push. Open this page in a second tab and broadcast: presence and messages fan out to every connection.
realtime.welcome: connected as {participant} · up to {max} characters, {messages} messages per {window}
realtime.gaveUp: gave up reconnecting; press Connect to try again
realtime.ticketRedeemed: Ticket redeemed; the socket is open. Broadcasts reach every connection this instance serves.
realtime.socketClosed: Socket closed. The ticket it used was already spent on the handshake.
realtime.sentNote: Every connection receives it, this one included.
telemetry.title: OpenTelemetry
telemetry.body: Generate an HTTP trace with two concurrent child spans, then inspect the captured span waterfall without leaving the page.
telemetry.hintExporting: Spans are captured in-process for the waterfall below and batch-exported to the configured OTLP endpoint.
telemetry.hintInProcess: Spans are captured in-process. Set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT to also export them over OTLP.
wasm.title: WebAssembly
wasm.body: Stream-compile a Rust module with WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming, then count primes with the same sieve in WebAssembly and in JavaScript and compare their 10-run average timings.
wasm.warmupMismatch: WebAssembly and JavaScript disagree during warmup: {wasm} vs {js}
wasm.iterationMismatch: WebAssembly and JavaScript disagree on iteration {iteration}: {wasm} vs {js}
wasm.note: 10-run averages after one untimed warmup; identical byte-array sieves must return matching counts. Timings vary by device.
activity.title: Activity
errors.code.unauthorized: Authentication is required or the session has expired.
errors.code.forbidden: The current role does not hold the required permission.
errors.code.payload_too_large: The request body is too large.
errors.code.unsupported_media_type: The request body must be encoded as JSON.
errors.code.https_required: This deployment only accepts HTTPS requests.
errors.code.rate_limited: Too many requests; wait a moment before retrying.
errors.code.request_timeout: The request exceeded the processing deadline.
errors.code.at_capacity: The server is at capacity; try again shortly.
errors.code.method_not_allowed: The endpoint does not support this method.
errors.code.not_found: The requested item was not found.
errors.code.conflict: The request conflicts with the current state.
